hypothesis: Preserving melee movement after defensive hits, with lower visible contact pressure as a shortest-path tie breaker, increases matched wins and mean tribute over the edit base without new own faults or fuel suspensions. Nonpositive win or tribute gain, or new reliability failures, falsifies this prediction.
mechanism_status: Unmeasured rules/source deduction; supplied final scores do not establish a per-turn cause.

source_mechanism.before: play_turn returns immediately after successful fight(false,true), even when melee can still walk.
source_mechanism.after: Compatible defensive hits and resets precede farm planning; optional exclusive damage spells wait until after attempted movement. Walk and dash choose lower visible basic-attack pressure only among equal shortest advancing steps.
source_mechanism.pressure: sum enemy strength * (2 if in current basic range, 1 if within range+1, else 0); at most six fresh visible enemy contacts; no hidden predictions.
source_mechanism.fallback: Below 28k movement fuel, pressure is zero and original strict-distance choice applies. Existing 45k planning/18k action floors remain. Current captures, channels, retreat, banking priority and roster retained.

opponent_source_findings.boss: ea15ef0f/f4b4f65e skirmish chases favorable targets to radius 4, trades in range, and retreats below local-power parity. Its pressure makes stationary equal trades a plausible opportunity cost, not a demonstrated trace cause.
opponent_source_findings.others: Alpha 82a14a04 uses timed camp rotation; beta 7cab9b0f uses reset farming and capital-aware gold valuation; these route systems were not transferred.
